summary: The filing is a Form 6-K press release announcing the early completion of Phase 2 earn-in requirements under an option agreement with Denison Mines, granting Foremost a majority interest in Athabasca uranium projects. The terms involve issuing up to 848,610 common shares valued at $2 million (based on pricing parameters) and completing over $8 million in exploration expenditures to earn a 51% interest (35.78% at Hatchet Lake). This is a contractual milestone, not a special situation. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. The structural notes indicate the milestone is achieved ~15 months ahead of the deadline. What to watch: continued exploration progress and potential future stage earn-ins.
